english.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for contacting someone by telephone.
This is the all-purpose everyday rendering when you mean telephone someone.
Use this as the all-purpose spoken Cantonese verb for calling someone by telephone or making a phone call.
This is the all-purpose spoken choice for making a phone call, including “dial 999”.
